pairs.target: zǎofàn de dàn guǒrán hái zài guō lǐ . sè lā gùyì děng tǎ wéi bèi hǎo bāo cái jiēgài , kàn tā yòu fàngxià bāo zhǎo bù , xiào dé jiānbǎng dōu zài dòng .
pairs.english: The breakfast eggs were indeed still in the pot. Sela deliberately waited until Tavi had shouldered his pack before lifting the lid; watching him put it down again to find a cloth, she laughed so hard her shoulders shook.
pairs.hanzi: 早饭的蛋果然还在锅里。瑟拉故意等塔维背好包才揭盖，看他又放下包找布，笑得肩膀都在动。

pairs.target: sòngdào jiēkǒu , tā méi tì tā zhěnglǐ lǐngzǐ , zhī jiào tā jiāng tiēzhe bèi de bāo dài sōngkāi yìdiǎn , miǎnde lùshang rè le yòu lǎnde tíng .
pairs.english: Seeing him to the street corner, she did not straighten his collar, only told him to loosen the strap against his back a little, before he became hot on the road and too lazy to stop.
pairs.hanzi: 送到街口，她没替他整理领子，只叫他将贴着背的包带松开一点，免得路上热了又懒得停。

pairs.target: nán ménwài de gōngchē guà zhe yíchuàn biǎn tóngpiàn , fēng yì chuī , shēngyīn bǐ chēlíng xì .
pairs.english: The public cart outside the south gate carried a string of flat copper pieces that sounded finer than the cart bell when the wind blew.
pairs.hanzi: 南门外的公车挂着一串扁铜片，风一吹，声音比车铃细。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yǐ jiāng liǎng rén de piào jiāogěi gǎnchē de nǚrén , zhèng tì tā fúzhù yìgēn zhē yǔpéng gān .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had already handed their two tickets to the woman driving and was holding a rain-canopy pole for her.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡已将两人的票交给赶车的女人，正替她扶住一根遮雨篷杆。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shéngtào lèjǐn , pāi qù shǒushàng de tǔ , cuī tā yě shàngchē , shuō zài zhàn zhe bāngmáng , biàn dé fù bàngè huǒjì de gōngqián gěi tā .
pairs.english: She tightened the rope loop, dusted the dirt off her hands and urged him aboard too, saying if he kept standing there helping, she would have to pay him half a worker's wages.
pairs.hanzi: 她把绳套勒紧，拍去手上的土，催他也上车，说再站着帮忙，便得付半个伙计的工钱给他。

pairs.target: liǎngpǐ mǔ mǎlā de chē , hòumiàn zhuāng zhe jǐgè cháng xiāng hé yìzhī zhúlóng . lóng lǐ liǎngzhī é bǎ zuǐ shēnchū lái , yílù zhuó zhe gài bù .
pairs.english: Two mares pulled the cart, which carried several long crates and a bamboo cage behind. Two geese stuck their beaks out of the cage and pecked the cover cloth all the way.
pairs.hanzi: 两匹母马拉的车，后面装着几个长箱和一只竹笼。笼里两只鹅把嘴伸出来，一路啄着盖布。

pairs.target: bào lóng de nánrén jiěshì shì sòng qù huàn zhǒng de , bù shā , gǎnchē de nǚrén shuō nà jiù gèng gāi guǎnhǎo zuǐ , tāmen yǐ chīdiào zìjǐ bàntiáo bǎngshéng .
pairs.english: The man holding the cage explained they were being sent to exchange breeding stock, not for slaughter. The driver said all the more reason to control their beaks: they had already eaten half her binding cord.
pairs.hanzi: 抱笼的男人解释是送去换种的，不杀，赶车的女人说那就更该管好嘴，它们已吃掉自己半条绑绳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéihé ruǎn héng āizhe zuòzài qiánpái , néng cóng péng biān kànjiàn lù .
pairs.english: Tavi and Ruan Heng sat together in the front row, able to see the road past the canopy's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维和阮衡挨着坐在前排，能从篷边看见路。

pairs.target: chéngqiáng zhuǎnguò qù zhīhòu , lù xiān chuānguò dīdīde càitián , zài yánzhe nánmiàn de shān lèi huǎnhuǎn táigāo .
pairs.english: Once the city wall fell behind, the road first crossed low vegetable fields, then slowly rose along the southern ridge.
pairs.hanzi: 城墙转过去之后，路先穿过低低的菜田，再沿着南面的山肋缓缓抬高。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhǔdàn ná chūlái fēn yígè gěi ruǎn héng , méi jí zhe ná tú , xiān kàn chēzhé cóng nǎ piàn tiánbiān ràoguòqù .
pairs.english: He took out the boiled eggs and gave one to Ruan Heng, without hurrying for his map; first he watched which field the wheel tracks curved around.
pairs.hanzi: 他将煮蛋拿出来分一个给阮衡，没急着拿图，先看车辙从哪片田边绕过去。

pairs.target: wǔqián , chē tíng zài yízuò shíqiáo běitóu . qiáobiān dā zhe mùpéng , pénglǐ guà le jiù pái , pángbiān yìzhāng xīn zhǐ gài zhe liǎnggè bùtóng de yìn .
pairs.english: Before noon the cart stopped at the north end of a stone bridge. A wooden shelter stood beside it, with an old sign inside and a new sheet beside it bearing two different seals.
pairs.hanzi: 午前，车停在一座石桥北头。桥边搭着木棚，棚里挂了旧牌，旁边一张新纸盖着两个不同的印。

pairs.target: gǎnchē de nǚrén kàn le yìyǎn , liǎnsè jiù chén le , shuō shàng yuè yǐ àn chēlún jiāo guò , zěnme jīnrì yòu àn cháng xiāng suàn .
pairs.english: The driver glanced at it and her expression darkened. She said she had already paid by the wheel last month; why charge by long crates again today?
pairs.hanzi: 赶车的女人看了一眼，脸色就沉了，说上月已按车轮交过，怎么今日又按长箱算。

pairs.target: shōuqián de rén búshì bīng , xiùkǒu mópò le , shǒushàng liú zhe bǔ qiáo huī .
pairs.english: The collector was not a soldier; his cuffs were worn through and bridge-repair dust remained on his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 收钱的人不是兵，袖口磨破了，手上留着补桥灰。

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe zhǐ shuō , zhī suàn shēnchū chēwěi de cháng huò , chēqián guī běipō , qiáomiàn qiǎngxiū de qián guī liǎngtóu hé shōu , zuórì cái bǎ nánbiān nà méi yìn sòng qí .
pairs.english: Pointing to the sheet, he said it applied only to long cargo extending past the cart's rear. Cart fees went to the north slope; emergency bridge-deck repair fees were collected jointly by both ends. The southern seal had only arrived yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 他指着纸说，只算伸出车尾的长货，车钱归北坡，桥面抢修的钱归两头合收，昨日才把南边那枚印送齐。

pairs.target: bào é de nánrén shuō zìjǐ tīngbùdǒng , zhī wèn guòqiáo háiyào děng duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: The man holding the geese said he did not understand, only asking how long they still had to wait to cross.
pairs.hanzi: 抱鹅的男人说自己听不懂，只问过桥还要等多久。

pairs.target: hòupái yìzhí hù zhe cháng xiāng de fùrén yě kāi le kǒu , shuō xiāng lǐ shì tì mèimei dài de chuāngkuàng , kōng de , yòu bù bǐ yídài liáng zhòng .
pairs.english: The woman who had been guarding the long crates in the back row spoke too: they held window frames for her younger sister, empty and no heavier than a sack of grain.
pairs.hanzi: 后排一直护着长箱的妇人也开了口，说箱里是替妹妹带的窗框，空的，又不比一袋粮重。

pairs.target: shōuqián de rén kàn le chēwěi , shuō shēnchū qù nàme cháng , búshì àn zhòng suàn .
pairs.english: The collector looked at the cart's rear and said it stuck out so far; weight was not the basis of the fee.
pairs.hanzi: 收钱的人看了车尾，说伸出去那么长，不是按重算。

pairs.target: gǎnchē de nǚrén jiāng chē tuì dào péng biān píngdì , xiàqù chāikāi yìbiān bǎngshéng , qǐng fùrén bǎ liǎnggè duǎn xiāng nuó dào qiánpái jiǎoxià .
pairs.english: The driver backed onto level ground beside the shelter, got down and undid the binding cord on one side, asking the woman to move two short crates to the foot of the front row.
pairs.hanzi: 赶车的女人将车退到棚边平地，下去拆开一边绑绳，请妇人把两个短箱挪到前排脚下。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng wèn yào buyào bāngmáng , tā shuō xiān ràngkāi zǒu dào jiù hǎo , bié wèile fú xiāng ràng é pǎo le .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng asked if she wanted help. She said just clear the aisle first; don't let the geese escape while helping with crates.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡问要不要帮忙，她说先让开走道就好，别为了扶箱让鹅跑了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bāo tídào xī shàng , hé ruǎn héng yìtóng jiāng jiǎo shōuhuí dèng xià .
pairs.english: Tavi lifted his pack onto his knees and, together with Ruan Heng, drew his feet beneath the bench.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把包提到膝上，和阮衡一同将脚收回凳下。

pairs.target: cháng xiāng zhuǎn jìn chēpéng , mòduān suōhuí le chēwěi yǐnèi , dàijià shì suǒyǒurén dōu zhǐnéng xié zhe fàng tuǐ .
pairs.english: The long crates swung inside the canopy, their ends now within the rear of the cart, at the cost of everyone having to sit with their legs at an angle.
pairs.hanzi: 长箱转进车篷，末端缩回了车尾以内，代价是所有人都只能斜着放腿。

pairs.target: shōuqián de rén rào chē kànguò , méi zài àn cháng huò shōu , zhī zài tā de chēpiào bèimiàn jì le yìbǐ .
pairs.english: The collector walked around to inspect the cart and no longer charged for long cargo, only making a note on the back of her ticket.
pairs.hanzi: 收钱的人绕车看过，没再按长货收，只在她的车票背面记了一笔。

pairs.target: tā réng bù gāoxìng , wèn xià tàng shìbushì yòu huàn pái . nà rén shuō bù zhīdào , zhǐ shì shàngmiàn sònglái de , zìjǐ yě bú yuàn tì pángrén āimà .
pairs.english: Still unhappy, she asked whether the sign would change again next trip. He said he did not know; the paper came from above, and he did not want to take abuse for others either.
pairs.hanzi: 她仍不高兴，问下趟是不是又换牌。那人说不知道，纸是上面送来的，自己也不愿替旁人挨骂。

pairs.target: huà dào zhèlǐ , tā shēnshǒu bāng tā tuī le yíxià chēlún , chē chóngxīn shànglù , qiáoxià de báishuǐ biàn cóng péng wài yìhuǎngérguò .
pairs.english: At that, he reached to help her push the wheel. The cart set off again and the white water beneath the bridge flashed past outside the canopy.
pairs.hanzi: 话到这里，他伸手帮她推了一下车轮，车重新上路，桥下的白水便从篷外一晃而过。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe piào bèi wèi gān de zì , xiǎngqǐ fēng zhàn nà zhī kōngxiāng . ruǎn héng què zhèng dītóu nuó zìjǐ de xuēzǐ , bàntiān zhǎo búdào yígè fàng zhí de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Looking at the still-wet writing on the ticket's back, Tavi thought of Wind Trestle's empty crate. Ruan Heng, meanwhile, was looking down and shifting his boots, unable for ages to find somewhere to straighten them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着票背未干的字，想起风栈那只空箱。阮衡却正低头挪自己的靴子，半天找不到一个放直的地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng wèn dehuà zànqiě shōuzhù , xiān bǎ zìjǐ nàbiān de xiǎoxiāng wǎng lǐ zhuǎn le bàncùn .
pairs.english: Tavi held back his question for now, first turning the little crate on his side inward half an inch.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想问的话暂且收住，先把自己那边的小箱往里转了半寸。

pairs.target: dào wǔfàn tíngkào chù , tā cái wèn ruǎn héng , bùtóng lùduàn shōu de qián zěnme fēn .
pairs.english: Only at the lunch stop did he ask Ruan Heng how fees collected by different road sections were divided.
pairs.hanzi: 到午饭停靠处，他才问阮衡，不同路段收的钱怎么分。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō jiùyuē shàng yǒu , shíjì shōu dédào duōshǎo yòu shì lìngyìhuíshì , dào le fēng zhàn , néng xiān kàn zhuǎnyùn huì gěi tāmen de zhàng , búyào ná jīntiān zhè yì péng rén dàngzuò zhěngtiáolù .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said it was in the old agreement, but how much could actually be collected was another matter. At Wind Trestle they could first look at the accounts the transfer association supplied; he should not take today's cartload of people for the entire road.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说旧约上有，实际收得到多少又是另一回事，到了风栈，能先看转运会给他们的账，不要拿今天这一棚人当作整条路。

pairs.target: wǔhòu fēng biànnuǎn le . chē guò liǎngdào wān , tóng jiē de shānjǐ zhōngyú cóng hòumiàn xiāoshī .
pairs.english: The wind grew warmer that afternoon. After two bends, Copperstep's ridge finally disappeared behind them.
pairs.hanzi: 午后风变暖了。车过两道弯，铜阶的山脊终于从后面消失。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǎnkāi lù tú , zài yìtiáo huà dé jí xì de xiǎoxī páng zhǎodào wǔfàn nà jiā diàn , yòu jiāng diànménkǒu de sānzhī liàng cài zhújià tiānshàngqù , zhècì méi ràng shǒuzhǐ yāzhù shānshì .
pairs.english: Tavi unfolded the route map and found the lunch shop beside a stream drawn very finely, then added the three vegetable-drying bamboo racks by its door, this time without letting his finger cover the contours.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维展开路图，在一条画得极细的小溪旁找到午饭那家店，又将店门口的三只晾菜竹架添上去，这次没让手指压住山势。

pairs.target: gǎnchē de nǚrén huítóu kàn tā , shuō zhújià dōngtiān yào shōu , zhǎo búdào bié mà mài fàn de .
pairs.english: The driver looked back and said the bamboo racks were put away in winter; don't blame the food seller if he couldn't find them.
pairs.hanzi: 赶车的女人回头看他，说竹架冬天要收，找不到别骂卖饭的。

pairs.target: tā zài pángbiān bǔ le jìjié , tā xiào , shuō zìjǐ yàoshi yě huì huà , néng bǎ yánlù qiàn tā cǎoliào de rén quán huà xiàlái , búyòng zài jì nàxiē tiāntiān biàn de pù míng .
pairs.english: He added the season beside it. She laughed and said if she could draw too, she could sketch everyone along the road who owed her fodder, instead of remembering those shop names that changed every day.
pairs.hanzi: 他在旁边补了季节，她笑，说自己要是也会画，能把沿路欠她草料的人全画下来，不用再记那些天天变的铺名。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tāmen dàodá guòyè de lù diàn , fēng zhàn háiyào míngrì cái dào . bào é de rén xiān qù zhǎoshuǐ , fùrén dǎkāi xiāng gài , ná bù cādiào chuāngkuàng pèng chū de huī .
pairs.english: At dusk they reached the roadside inn for the night; Wind Trestle was still a day away. The man with the geese went for water first, while the woman opened her crate and wiped dust off the window frames with a cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚他们到达过夜的路店，风栈还要明日才到。抱鹅的人先去找水，妇人打开箱盖，拿布擦掉窗框碰出的灰。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài yuàn wài , kànjiàn gèng dī de gǔ lǐ liàng qǐ jǐ cù dēng , měi yícù zhījiān dōu gé zhe dàpiàn mùsè .
pairs.english: Standing outside the courtyard, Tavi saw several clusters of lights come on in the lower valley, each separated by a vast expanse of dusk.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在院外，看见更低的谷里亮起几簇灯，每一簇之间都隔着大片暮色。

pairs.target: tā mō dào yīdài lǐ zhé hǎo de shōuxìn chù , méiyǒu qǔchū lái . yuànnèi yǒurén jiào kāifàn , tā dāying yìshēng , zhuǎnshēn shí wéndào yìgǔ bù shúxī de xiāngqì , xiàng cǎoyè róusuì hòu luò jìn rèyóu , biàn wèn duān pán de háizi , nà shì shénme cài .
pairs.english: He felt the folded postal address in his pocket without taking it out. Someone inside called that dinner was ready. He answered and, turning, smelled an unfamiliar fragrance, like crushed leaves falling into hot oil, and asked the child carrying the plates what the dish was.
pairs.hanzi: 他摸到衣袋里折好的收信处，没有取出来。院内有人叫开饭，他答应一声，转身时闻到一股不熟悉的香气，像草叶揉碎后落进热油，便问端盘的孩子，那是什么菜。
